audit.note: logo Image and profile Avatar presses toast client-side via control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show (static texts, roundtrip-free) - the app is init-only

deviations.what: the two 'Prоduct Name' Title texts (V.view.xml:19, the productName Title, and :72 - there is no Menu and no Select in this sample; the sidecar said "menu/select" until 2026-08-23) contain CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER O (U+043E) in place of the Latin o - reproduced verbatim from the original V.view.xml, which carries the same homoglyph (upstream defect kept for 1:1 fidelity; do not ASCII-fix it).

The SAP-logo Image and profile Avatar presses show client-side MessageToasts ('Logo pressed!' / 'Avatar pressed!'), matching the original onLogoPressed / onAvatarPressed. The original's Device.media handler does two things per screen range, and the port reproduces neither: it toggles productName/secondTitle/searchField/searchButton visibility, AND every one of its four branches raises a MessageToast ('Screen width is corresponding to <range>'). onInit calls the handler immediately, and the StdExt range set always resolves to one of the four names, so the ORIGINAL SHOWS A TOAST ON EVERY LOAD and the port shows none - a user-visible message lost at load time, not only on a breakpoint crossing. The visibility branch keeps its static initial state (searchButton visible='false'). Three of the four ranges could be expressed declaratively through the {device>/media/range} model (CAPABILITIES, shipped 2026-08-05, Std set: Phone/Tablet/Desktop); LargeDesktop is the 1440px point of StdExt and has no counterpart, and a load-time toast has no declarative form at all. **e2e-verified 2026-07-30** (transpiled-framework interaction, scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs): the logo Image press toasts 'Logo pressed!'; the Avatar press is the identical wire but not exercised, and the Device.media visibility branch stays out of scope. **e2e-verified 2026-08-04** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_134.mjs).

Both ToolHeaders, all OverflowToolbarLayoutData priorities/groups, the ToolHeaderUtilitySeparator and the OverflowToolbarButtons are reproduced 1:1, including the original's Cyrillic-o typo in 'Prоduct Name'. The SAP_Logo.png and Woman_avatar_01.png srcs are the original's host-relative test-resources/sap/tnt/images/ paths rewritten to the OpenUI5 host https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/sap/tnt/images/ per the runtime asset-URL rule (app 152 precedent).

sap.m.Avatar (control @since 1.73) is used 1:1 as the profile avatar in both ToolHeaders (src image, displaySize XS, press). Newer than UI5 1.71; declared per the property-171 policy (control-level, app 152 precedent), so the app needs UI5 >= 1.73 to render the avatars. Found by the 2026-07-27 review sweep.

the icon `sap-icon://da` reached the SAP icon font in 1.96 and is kept 1:1 from the original V.view.xml, which names it on the 'Joule' OverflowToolbarButton. Newer than the 1.71 floor: there IconPool resolves nothing and the button renders with NO icon, silently - the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.96 to show it.
